An incomplete and worn Roman copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine dating to AD 330-335 (Reece Period 17). GLORIA EXERC-ITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers with two standards between them. Obverse description: Diademed, bust right. Obverse inscription:Illegible.
